title: Beyond Vision-Language Models: Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs for Emotion Recognition in Artworks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emotion recognition in artworks remains challenging because affective meaning is often subjective, implicit, and shaped by relationships between visual form and semantic associations. While vision-language models provide strong multimodal representations, direct image-to-emotion prediction may overlook explicit relations among formal, semantic, and affective cues that support emotional interpretation. This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes, including color, brushstroke, composition, light-shadow, line quality, and extracted visual entities. The graph learns feature-emotion associations for dominant emotion prediction, with valence-arousal structure modeled through an optional hierarchical auxiliary affect module. translated_title: 超越视觉-语言模型：用于艺术品情感识别的视觉-语义情感图
translated_abstract: 艺术品中的情感识别仍然具有挑战性，因为情感意义往往是主观的、隐含的，并由视觉形式与语义关联之间的关系所塑造。虽然视觉-语言模型提供了强大的多模态表示，但直接的图像到情感预测可能忽略了支持情感解读的形式、语义和情感线索之间的显式关系。本文提出了视觉-语义情感图（VSAG），这是一个基于图的框架，通过可解释的特征节点来表示艺术品，包括色彩、笔触、构图、光影、线条质感以及提取出的视觉实体。该图学习特征与情感之间的关联以预测主导情感，并通过一个可选的层次化辅助情感模块对效价-唤醒结构进行建模。我们在EmoArt-5k数据集上，将VSAG和VSAG-TopK与使用Qwen3-VL和InternVL3.5的直接视觉-语言模型推理进行了对比评估。结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出视觉-语义情感图（VSAG）框架，通过色彩、笔触、构图、光影、线条等可解释特征节点构建图结构来学习特征与情感的关联，在艺术品情感识别任务上超越了直接使用视觉-语言模型进行推理的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Visual-Semantic Affect Graphs (VSAG), a graph-based framework that represents artworks through interpretable feature nodes such as color, brushstroke, and composition to learn feature-emotion associations, outperforming direct vision-language model inference on emotion recognition in artworks.
